_readme: Settings for scripts/generate-voice.js. direction adds eleven_v3 audio tags in front of a line (keyed by the audio file name). Test lines have no tags: they are the reference the accent score compares against. A place can give each character its own voice (characters.<id>.voiceId, designed from characters.<id>.design with scripts/design-voices.js); placeSpeaker says the placement lines.

senga.voiceName: Senga (Glasgow seagull), on Sadman's account: run with that key

hamish.voiceName: Big Hamish (Glasgow bus driver), on Sadman's account: run with that key

design.voice_description: A warm, authentic Mumbai, India English accent with natural Hinglish, unmistakably Mumbaikar, not generic or exaggerated. Late 20s man, quick, sharp and cheeky, runs a busy chai stall by the station and knows everyone, fast and friendly. Natural, fluent, confident, a fun cartoon crow character in a game.
